units.source_text: 可是，到了有个纺织厂烟囱的火车站，

en.t: But when they reached a station with the chimney of a textile mill,

units.source_text: 老人急忙从行李架上取下柳条箱，从窗口卸到站台上，

en.t: the old man hurriedly took the wicker trunk down from the luggage rack and unloaded it through the window onto the platform,

units.source_text: 对姑娘留下一句“那么，有缘还会相逢的”，就下车走了。

en.t: after leaving the girl with the words, "Well then, if fate allows, we will meet again," he got off and went away.
